summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Brazilian subsidiary resumed a voluntary tender offer (OPAV) on the B3 exchange to acquire 116,110,717 common shares of Brava Energia S.A., representing approximately 25% of its share capital. The revised offer incorporates CVM recommendations and is expected to remain open until August 5, 2026, when the auction would occur. The transaction remains subject to regulatory clearances and other conditions. Ecopetrol is the largest Colombian integrated energy company. Investors should monitor regulatory approvals and auction results for risk-arb assessment.
